name: GameLand
description:
🇫🇷 : Le mini-jeu de retour en France ! 🇫🇷

GameLand est un serveur de mini-jeux qui en propose plusieurs : le Hikabrain, le UHC Run ainsi que des jeux en solo.

GameLand ouvre ses portes le vendredi 16 octobre à 12 h ! 

🇬🇧 : Mini-games are back in France! 🇫🇷

GameLand is a mini-game server offering several game modes: Hikabrain, UHC Run, as well as single-player games.

GameLand opens its doors on Friday, October 16 at 12 PM!
